title: Besançon 1485 original missal: bounded original-page and rights review

candidate_lookup.scope: Scratch search receipt; no installation locator retained publicly.

isolated_validation_v3.scope: Exact v3 source graph and manifest pins; v4 changes only review links/status and validation pointers.

coverage_rows.result: Selected actual original calendar, Ordo, Canon and colophon images inspected; existing catalogue census remains bounded and unchanged.

uses.printed_authority: The printer notice explicitly attributes the work to the express mandate of Caroli de Novocastro, described as Archimandrite bisuntini. No separate date or act text is claimed.
uses.local_use: The printer notice expressly names Besançon use/customary and the final colophon the Besançon metropolitan church. This is a source-local printed-use claim, not inferred from the holding library.
uses.reception: No actual local reception or transition established.

facts.title: Missale Bisuntinense
facts.imprint: Salins; Jean Des Prés, Benoît Bigot and Claude Bodram

catalogue_evidence.limit: Catalogue facts are attributed; original printed colophons independently establish 1485, Salins and the Besançon customary.

limitations: Forty selected original page images were acquired and visually inspected; the complete 606-image facsimile was not acquired. The 606-entry API enumeration is metadata, not a facsimile or a whole-book extent census.
Library catalogue reports [306] leaves and a missing final blank. Neither catalogue extent nor 606 media entries certifies copy completeness or whole-book transcription.

No conventional printed title leaf was identified in the inspected first three viewer images; Missale Bisuntinense is the catalogue title. Edition identity is independently grounded in the two actual printed colophons.

Printer notice at 267 is not a separately dated promulgation instrument. The printed authority claim does not establish actual reception, continued local use, a substantive textual recension, historical parentage or a version transition.
Original image delivery is explicitly restricted against public redistribution. No JPEG, raw API wrapper, screenshot, OCR or image-derived facsimile payload is proposed for publication.
No liturgical-text payload or native-book binding is proposed. Identified incipits are locus labels and do not constitute a collated literal text.

The generic legal page and raw API were read for current delivery terms. Its private security/profile/analytics objects, headers and transport values do not enter any proposed canonical record or public receipt.
Gallica 1497 access failures were supplied in the parent brief and were not retried or represented as new searches here. No exhaustive access-negative claim is made.

Viewer images 1, 2, 3 and 400 are physical-copy context only: manuscript preliminary, separate catalogue-dated 1483 indulgence sheet and reverse, and added engraving. They are not attributed to the 1485 printed contents; no public-domain assertion or separate intellectual-work/date identity is assigned to those four contextual objects.
literal_text_status: No native text, complete book, complete constituent collation or source-body redistribution proposed.
independent_review_limit: The independent review pins the frozen v3 source packet. All51 source TOML manifests,40 image identities and four inventory-change preimages are unchanged in this review-linked derivative. The v4 review-envelope delta is checked separately; no complete-book or native-text acceptance is implied.
